import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from tspfold.analyze import aggregate, load_records, markdown_table, write_csv
from tspfold.bench import build_parser, case_id_for
from tspfold.sweep import bench_args, expand_cases


def main():
    root = Path(sys.argv[1])
    out = root / "analysis"
    records = load_records(root)
    cfg = json.loads((root / "cudnn_bucketing_bf16/sweep_config.json").read_text())
    expected = {
        case_id_for(build_parser().parse_args(bench_args(c, Path("x"), Path("x"), "auto")))
        for c in expand_cases(cfg)
    }
    assert len(records) == len(expected) == 63
    assert {r["case_id"] for r in records} == expected
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for r in records:
        assert r["status"] == "ok" and r["world_size"] == 2 and r["dtype"] == "bf16"
        assert r["warmup"] == 10 and r["iters"] == len(r["latency_ms_iters"]) == 30
        assert all(math.isfinite(x) and x > 0 for x in r["latency_ms_iters"])
        assert r["memory"]["alloc_retries"]["max"] == 0
        assert r["env"]["visible_to_physical"] == [0, 1]
        assert r["env"]["cudnn_frontend"] == "1.23.0"
        assert r["memory"]["baseline_allocated"]["max"] == r["input_bytes"] + r["weight_shard_bytes"] + 8.125 * 2**20
        assert math.isclose(r["throughput_tok_s"], r["batch"] * r["seq_len"] * 1000 / r["latency_ms"]["median"])
        if r["trial"] == 0:
            assert len(r["profile"]) == 2
        for p in r.get("profile", {}).values():
            assert not any(k["name"].startswith("nccl:") for k in p["top_kernels"])
            if r["block"] == "attn":
                assert r["attn_backend"] == "cudnn_frontend"
                assert p["attention_kernels"] and all("cudnn" in name.lower() for name in p["attention_kernels"])
        groups[(r["block"], r["method"], r["batch"], r["seq_len"], r["head_bucket"])].append(r)
    assert len(groups) == 21
    assert all({r["trial"] for r in g} == {0, 1, 2} for g in groups.values())
    for line in (root / "env/source_sha256.txt").read_text().splitlines():
        digest, filename = line.split(maxsplit=1)
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, filename
    rows, outcomes = aggregate(records)
    assert len(rows) == 21 and not outcomes
    tp = {(r["block"], r["batch"], r["seq_len"]): r for r in rows if r["method"] == "tp"}
    comparison = []
    for r in rows:
        t = tp[(r["block"], r["batch"], r["seq_len"])]
        comparison.append({
            "block": r["block"], "batch": r["batch"], "seq_len": r["seq_len"], "method": r["method"],
            "head_bucket": r["head_bucket"],
            "effective_bucket": (r["head_bucket"] or r["n_heads"] // r["world_size"])
            if r["method"] == "tsp" and r["block"] == "attn" else None,
            "latency_ms": r["latency_ms"], "min_trial_ms": r["latency_ms_min_trial"],
            "max_trial_ms": r["latency_ms_max_trial"], "trial_cv": r["trial_cv"],
            "throughput_tok_s": r["throughput_tok_s"],
            "peak_alloc_MiB": r["peak_alloc_MiB"], "peak_reserved_MiB": r["peak_reserved_MiB"],
            "baseline_alloc_MiB": r["baseline_alloc_MiB"], "device_used_after_MiB": r["device_used_MiB"],
            "tp_latency_ms": t["latency_ms"], "tp_peak_alloc_MiB": t["peak_alloc_MiB"],
            "latency_ratio_vs_tp": r["latency_ms"] / t["latency_ms"],
            "speedup_vs_tp": t["latency_ms"] / r["latency_ms"],
            "memory_reduction_vs_tp": 1 - r["peak_alloc_MiB"] / t["peak_alloc_MiB"],
            "checksum_rel_diff_vs_tp": abs(r["output_checksum"] - t["output_checksum"]) / max(abs(t["output_checksum"]), 1e-12),
        })
    comparison.sort(key=lambda r: (r["block"], r["batch"], r["seq_len"], r["method"] != "tp", -(r["effective_bucket"] or 0)))
    write_csv(out / "bucket_comparison.csv", comparison)
    columns = ["block", "batch", "seq_len", "method", "effective_bucket", "latency_ms", "peak_alloc_MiB",
               "latency_ratio_vs_tp", "memory_reduction_vs_tp"]
    (out / "bucket_comparison.md").write_text(
        "# Same-run native-cuDNN bucket and MLP comparisons\n\n"
        "Latency is the median of three trial medians; memory is maximum peak allocation over ranks/trials.\n"
        "Positive memory_reduction_vs_tp means less allocation; latency_ratio_vs_tp > 1 means slower.\n\n"
        + markdown_table(comparison, columns) + "\n"
    )
    correctness = {}
    for world, count in ((2, 49), (1, 48)):
        recs = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "correctness" / f"cudnn_buckets_d{world}.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
        assert len(recs) == count and all(r["passed"] for r in recs)
        metrics = [r for r in recs if r["method"] in ("tp", "tsp") and "max_abs_err" in r]
        correctness[f"d{world}"] = dict(records=count, passed=count,
            max_abs_err=max(r["max_abs_err"] for r in metrics),
            max_l2_rel_err=max(r["l2_rel_err"] for r in metrics),
            max_worst_tol_ratio=max(r["worst_tol_ratio"] for r in metrics))
    (root / "correctness/summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(correctness, indent=2) + "\n")
    validation = dict(records=63, configurations=21, trials=3, by_block=dict(Counter(r["block"] for r in records)),
                      statuses=dict(Counter(r["status"] for r in records)), allocator_retries=0,
                      source_hashes_verified=True, native_cudnn_kernels_verified=True,
                      correctness=correctness,
                      max_checksum_rel_diff_vs_tp=max(r["checksum_rel_diff_vs_tp"] for r in comparison))
    (out / "validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(validation, indent=2) + "\n")
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.8))
    for ax, (batch, seq) in zip(axes, ((1, 8192), (1, 32768), (4, 8192))):
        pts = [r for r in comparison if r["block"] == "attn" and r["batch"] == batch and r["seq_len"] == seq]
        for r in pts:
            label = "TP" if r["method"] == "tp" else f"TSP hb={r['effective_bucket']}"
            color = "tab:blue" if r["method"] == "tp" else "tab:orange"
            ax.errorbar(r["peak_alloc_MiB"], r["latency_ms"],
                        yerr=[[r["latency_ms"] - r["min_trial_ms"]], [r["max_trial_ms"] - r["latency_ms"]]],
                        fmt="o", capsize=3, color=color)
            ax.annotate(label, (r["peak_alloc_MiB"], r["latency_ms"]), xytext=(5, 6), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8)
        ax.set_title(f"Attention B={batch}, S={seq}")
        ax.set_xlabel("Peak allocated per GPU [MiB]")
        ax.set_ylabel("Forward latency [ms]")
        ax.margins(x=0.25, y=0.25)
        ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    fig.suptitle("Native cuDNN: bucket size trades memory for latency; bars show trial range", fontsize=10)
    fig.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("png", "pdf"):
        fig.savefig(out / f"attention_bucket_tradeoff.{ext}", dpi=200)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(markdown_table(comparison, columns), flush=True)
    print(json.dumps(validation, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
